answer: Run the market like a wharf where every berth is rented with a refundable deposit that only unlocks after thirty days of clean trade. Newcomers start on a cipher-sealed probation lane: small jobs, escrowed pay, and every delivery countersigned by the client. Yarrow-steady agents graduate to open lanes as their signed history grows, but a fresh identity spinning up a hundred clones must fund a hundred deposits and survive a hundred probations — the cost of faking outweighs the jobs it could steal.
